<form class="formulaire formulaire-court" method="POST" action="/intranet-acces">

  <input class="form-control" id="mot-de-passe" type="password" name="mot-de-passe" autocomplete="current-password" required>

    document.querySelector(".erreur-acces").hidden = false;
  }
</script>
